svg.aria-label: Exposure drawn as rings, from public on the open internet at the edge to restricted at the center, and criticality as three levels shown by what happens when the component fails.
svg.title: The two facts a component declares
svg.desc: Exposure is how reachable a component is: public, anyone on the internet, no sign-in; authenticated, on the internet, behind a login; internal, only from inside your network or VPN; restricted, inside your network and locked down further. The rings are brightest at the edge, where reach is widest. Criticality is the business impact if it fails: critical, an outage or data loss for the business; important, degraded service, but no outage; supporting, limited impact, easily worked around.
